issue_context.title: Under certain lazy collect conditions: Vstack column names don't match
issue_context.body:
### Polars version checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Issue description

I want to join a dataframe (containing lists of strings column: "a") to itself recursively, so that I build up combinations of "a". Some of these combinations are already present in the dataframe, so I am concating the filtered original dataframe at each recursive level (the filtering is not shown in the example for simplicity).

However, I get an error in Vstack with mismatching column names that only occurs when collecting the lazy pipeline through `pl.concat([dfs]).collect()` and not through collecting the pieces individually (or just using non-lazy dataframes). I think I narrowed it down to the `groupby`-`agg` perhaps being pushed too far up the stack or rearranging the columns?

Its very convoluted, so if you have any suggestions for getting combinations from a list column in polars, it would also be greatly appreciated.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

df = (
    pl.DataFrame({"a": [["1"], ["1"], ["3"]], "b": [["4"], ["5"], ["6"]]})
)

dfs = [df.lazy().select("a", "b", a2 = pl.col("a"))]
for n in range(1, 3):
    dfs.append(
        pl.concat([
            dfs[-1]
            .explode("a2")
            .join(dfs[0].explode("a2"), on="a2", how="inner", suffix="_2")
            .select("a", "b"),
            # Original df
            df
            .lazy()
            .select("a", "b")
        ])
        .groupby(pl.col("a").list.sort().list.join(","))
        .agg(
            pl.col("b").flatten(),
            )
        .select(
            pl.col("a").str.split(","),
            pl.col("b").list.unique(),
            a2 = pl.col("a").str.split(",")
            )
    )

pl.concat(dfs).collect()
# exceptions.ShapeError: unable to vstack, column names don't match: "b" and "a"
```


### Expected behavior

```python
# This version of collecting works
pl.concat([dfs[0].collect(), dfs[1].collect(), dfs[2].collect()])
```

comments: Thanks for the report. This is due to cse. To fix it (until we have fixed it here) set `.collect(common_subplan_elimination=False)`
